_about: Quixotic AI quality regression suite V2 (owner request 2026-10-26: 'CRITICAL QUALITY FIXES V2'). Each case runs live against the API: the history turns first (same chat), then the input. Fixed checks run in code; 'must' criteria are graded by an LLM judge. Run: python -m evaluation.quality_v2.run --repeat 2

cases.input: Hey, I really like your artwork, but I need some time to think about it.
cases.expected_structure: only the translation, one line, no quotes or notes
must: Natural Roman Urdu (Urdu in English letters) with the same meaning: likes the artwork, needs time to think
No explanation, greeting or quotation marks added

cases.input: Bhai mujhe tumhara design acha laga lekin abhi mere paas budget nahi hai.
must: English with the same meaning: liked the design, no budget right now
Keeps the casual tone (e.g. 'Bro' for 'Bhai')
No added notes or greetings

cases.input: ngl ur emotes look fire, how much would 3 of them cost?
must: Roman Urdu with the same meaning (emotes look great, asks the price of 3)
Keeps the informal, casual tone
Does not invent a price

cases.input: Ali bhai, NightOwl wala logo kal tak bhej dena please, stream se pehle chahiye.
must: English with the same meaning (send the NightOwl logo by tomorrow, needed before the stream)
Names Ali and NightOwl unchanged

cases.input: yaar client ne bola hai ke colours thore dull lag rahe hain, can we make them brighter?
must: Mixed text, mostly Roman Urdu: translated fully into English with the same meaning (client says the colours look dull, asks to make them brighter)
Does not ask which language

cases.input: Aap ka logo almost ready hai, bas colours confirm kar dein.
must: Spanish translation with the same meaning (logo almost ready, please confirm the colours)
Only the translation

history.q: Give me 2 emote ideas for a frog themed streamer

cases.input: translate into roman urdu: Thanks for waiting! The sketch is ready, let me know what you think.
must: Roman Urdu translation of the given sentence only, same meaning
Previous emote ideas are not mentioned

cases.input: isko english mein translate karo: bhai price thora kam karo, main regular customer hoon
must: English translation (lower the price a little, I'm a regular customer)
No reply suggestions or advice added

history.q: Can you also make a matching banner?

cases.input: theek hai, kal tak bata dunga
must: English translation: okay, I'll let you know by tomorrow

cases.input: Give me one idea for a mascot logo for a client who loves samurai and the colour red. One paragraph, 5-6 lines.
cases.expected_structure: exactly one idea, one paragraph, no bullets, about 60-120 words
must: Exactly one idea
It is a mascot logo (a character emblem usable as a logo), not a banner or poster
Uses samurai and red
Specific visual details the client can picture (character, pose/expression, key shapes, colours, where the name goes)
Not generic filler

cases.input: 3 emote ideas for a cozy cat-themed Twitch streamer, pastel colours
must: Exactly 3 ideas
All are emotes (single expressive character, readable at small size)
Pastel colours and a cozy cat theme
The 3 ideas are clearly different emotions/uses

history.q: Give me 2 cyberpunk banner ideas with neon pink and blue

cases.input: Now a detailed concept for a fantasy wolf profile picture in green and gold.
must: A profile picture (PFP) concept, not a banner
Fantasy wolf in green and gold
Detailed, meaningful design information (composition, character, colours, lighting/effects) without filler
Nothing carried over from the earlier cyberpunk ideas

cases.input: Explain a Valorant-themed Twitch overlay idea in purple and black, in simple everyday English, short.
must: A stream overlay (webcam frame / alerts / stream elements), not a logo or banner
Purple and black, Valorant-inspired
Simple everyday words, no design jargon

cases.input: write a greeting message for someone new I want to talk to on discord
must: Exactly one short greeting message
Natural and casual, like a real Discord user
No sales pitch or service offer
Does not assume the person is a streamer or content creator
No exaggerated compliments or invented shared interests

history.q: write a greeting message for a potential client on discord

cases.input: he might not be a streamer, rewrite it
must: Exactly one revised greeting, not several options
No streamer assumption
Short, human, not promotional

cases.input: give me 2 casual discord greetings, slang is fine
must: Exactly 2 messages
Casual Discord slang, natural
No sales pitch

history.q: Client feedback: "I really like the overall design, but the background feels too busy. Can you make the character a little bigger, use darker blue, and move my username to the bottom?" Explain this to me in Roman Urdu.

cases.input: Write an overall reply in 4-5 lines.
must: One reply addressed directly to the client, in English
Acknowledges they like the overall design
Covers ALL four changes: cleaner/less busy background, bigger character, darker blue, username at the bottom
Does not claim the changes are already done; no delivery time promised
Friendly, natural, 4-5 lines

cases.input: Client said: "love the colours and the pose!! but the sword looks too thin, the eyes feel a bit lifeless, and can the logo text be more readable? also not a fan of the purple glow tbh". Summarize the requested changes.
cases.expected_structure: short list of requested changes (and what they like)
must: Lists the changes: thicker sword, livelier eyes, more readable logo text, remove/reduce the purple glow
Notes what they like (colours, pose) so it is kept
A summary for the employee, not a client reply

cases.input: client feedback: "the banner is cool but my name is hard to read and the dragon looks kinda cartoonish, i wanted it more realistic". write a reply i can send
must: Addresses both points: name readability and a more realistic dragon
Written to the client, friendly and natural
No completed-work claims, no delivery promise

cases.input: my client plays Minecraft and likes calm vibes. explain a YouTube banner concept the way I'd tell him on discord
must: Conversational, written as if talking to the client (e.g. 'So I was thinking...')
A YouTube banner concept with specific visuals tied to Minecraft and calm vibes
Explains why it would look good without hype
No headings, no jargon, no questions back

cases.input: Client wants a custom skin for his PS5. He plays Call of Duty and likes a dark military style. Give me a concept.
must: A physical console skin for the PS5 (side panels / faceplates, centre, controller optional), not a banner or logo
Dark military / Call of Duty inspired visuals with specific colour placement
Practical for print: mentions keeping clear of vents, ports, buttons or using the exact PS5 template/edition
Natural, easy to picture

cases.input: customer wants a custom skin for his gaming console that matches his gaming style and makes it look unique. give one idea
must: Exactly one console-skin idea, not a banner/PFP/logo
Flexible concept with reasonable assumptions
Notes that the exact console model (and edition) is needed before print preparation

history.q: Client wants a custom skin for his PS5. He plays Call of Duty and likes a dark military style. Give me a concept.

cases.input: now generate an image of this concept
must: The image prompt describes the PS5 console skin concept from the chat (dark military style), not a generic image

cases.input: generate a mascot logo of a red samurai fox with the text KITSU
must: Image prompt keeps: mascot logo, red samurai fox, the exact text KITSU

cases.input: what is our refund policy?
must: Does not invent a refund policy, percentages or day counts; says it is not in the company knowledge (or quotes approved knowledge)

cases.input: A client wrote: "hey how much for an emote?" what should I reply?
must: Gives client reply options in English
No invented price

cases.input: client ne English mein likha hai: "Can I get the logo by Friday?" mujhe kya reply karna chahiye?
cases.expected_structure: explanation in Roman Urdu, client messages in English
must: Client messages (to send) are in English
Any explanation to the employee is in Roman Urdu
No delivery date promised
